sous_titre: Millions de prises fibre recensées, relevés de fin 2024 à avril 2026

series.nom: Prises fibre recensées aux États Unis

Fin 2024.texte: there are now a total of 88.1 million homes passed with fiber in the U.S.

Fin 2025.texte: totaling 98.3 million FTTH passings when including homes with more than one passing

Avril 2026.texte: nearly 100 million fiber passings have taken place, marking over 60% of households
